subject: NimblePay onboarding — buyer intake & remit details request
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: NimblePay Onboarding <onboarding@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NimblePay onboarding — buyer intake & remit details request

Hi Olivia / NimblePay team,

Welcome — excited to kick off vendor setup for NimblePay. To get you activated in our procurement/payables system we need a few items so Finance can create the vendor record and map remit-to instructions. Could you please provide the following by EOD Wednesday (10/14)?

1) Legal entity name (exact as appears on W-9 or tax docs)
2) Corporate address (street, city, state/province, country, ZIP/postal)
3) Tax ID / EIN and W-9 (PDF)
4) Remit-to details: preferred remit type (ACH or wire), remit-to name, bank account holder name, account number, routing/ABA (for US) or SWIFT/IBAN as applicable
5) Bank letter or voided check that shows account name and routing (PDF)
6) Invoicing email and billing contact + PO requirements (are POs required, and if so what header fields must match?)

We’ve attached our buyer intake template and ACH instructions for reference (Drive link below). Once we have the W-9 + bank proof we can create the vendor record and issue a test $0.01 ACH verification as needed. Marissa (Finance) and Laura (Legal) are CC'd for any contract/terms questions.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xA-BuyerIntake-templates
DocuSign (ACH form): https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-ACH-TEMPLATE

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply so we can keep this on the standard onboarding timeline.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblepay.com>

Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NimblePay onboarding — buyer intake & remit details request

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I've attached the W-9 and a bank letter.

- Legal entity: NimblePay, Inc.
- Address: 120 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
- Tax ID/EIN: 12-3456789 (see attached W-9)
- Remit type: ACH preferred
- Remit-to name: NimblePay, Inc.
- Account holder name: NimblePay, Inc.
- Routing/ABA: 111000025
- Account number: 1234567890

Attachments: nimblepay_w9.pdf, nimblepay_bank_letter.pdf

A few notes:
- We typically accept POs but do not require them for recurring platform fees under $2,500. For POs, the PO number must be included in the invoice body and match the Billing Contact's email.
- Invoicing contact: billing@nimblepay.com (Invoices@nimblepay.com also monitored)

If you need the signed ACH authorization we can route a DocuSign — I’ve attached a completed ACH form in draft and can sign/execute if needed.

Best,
Olivia
Senior Ops Lead, NimblePay
olivia.chen@nimblepay.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

On Mon, Oct 11, 2026 at 9:45 AM Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblepay.com> wrote:
> Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I've attached the W-9 and a bank letter.

Thanks, Olivia — this is great and moves us forward. A couple follow-ups from Finance/Legal:

- Marissa: can you confirm whether Redwood requires a signed ACH authorization for first-time vendors? Our policy shows we prefer a signed DocuSign for ACH but can accept bank letter + voided check for low-risk vendors.
- Laura: legal asked to confirm the exact legal entity on the W-9 matches how we create the vendor name (NimblePay, Inc.). If you have an executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) or PO terms, please send or let us know where it's housed.

Olivia — two small asks to finish the activation: 1) if you could sign & return the ACH DocuSign (link below) or upload a signed PDF, and 2) can you confirm whether invoices should be routed to billing@nimblepay.com or invoices@nimblepay.com? We'll use the billing email as the default billing contact until you confirm.

DocuSign ACH template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-ACH-TEMPLATE

If both items come back today we can create the vendor and queue a test verification.

— Vanessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NimblePay onboarding — buyer intake & remit details request

Thanks, team — copying next steps from Finance:

- Marissa confirms: we require the W-9 + bank proof to create the vendor. A signed ACH authorization is preferred but not strictly required if a bank letter and W-9 are provided; we will still run a micro-deposit verification before first payment.
- PO policy: Redwood requires POs for one-time vendor payments or any invoice > $5,000. For recurring SaaS/platform fees we can process without a PO but must have an approved SOW or contract in the system.
- Once Vanessa confirms the final billing contact/email and we receive the signed ACH or bank proof, we'll provision NimblePay in Ariba (our vendor system) and send a confirmation with the vendor ID and remit instructions.

Olivia — can you please confirm which invoicing email we should use (billing@nimblepay.com or invoices@nimblepay.com)? If you can sign the ACH today we'll aim to create the vendor record this afternoon.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
